summary: BridgeBio Pharma filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with KKR Genetic Disorder L.P. for a secondary offering of 5,000,000 shares at $78.00 per share. The selling stockholder receives all proceeds; BridgeBio receives none and acts solely as filer. The offering, priced August 13, 2026, under a Form S-3ASR shelf, closed August 17, 2026. Underwriters include William Blair, Goldman Sachs, and KKR Capital Markets. This is a routine shelf takedown by an existing stockholder, not a special situation. No strategic event, tender, or change of control; the registrant's role is passive issuer of shares, with no proceeds to the company.
